title: 341_110677_Numerical_File,_5-2500
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Air Intelligence Information Report (IR 193-55) detailing observations made by a US delegation, including Senator Richard Russell, while traveling by rail through the USSR in October 1955.

incidents.summary: Three US observers (Senator Richard Russell, Lt. Col. E.U. Hathaway, and Mr. Ruben Efron) witnessed two unconventional disc-shaped aircraft ascending vertically near a railway line in the Trans-Caucasus region.
incidents.quote: two round and circular unconventional aircraft resembling flying discs or flying saucers were seen taking off almost vertically one minute apart
